title: The uniqueness of smooth stationary black holes
description: Research article: The uniqueness of smooth stationary black holes
summary: The article studies uniqueness of smooth stationary vacuum black holes without assuming analyticity. This collection presents a conditional theorem with explicit exterior-section, end-access, and Kerr-identification hypotheses.

The proof uses a Harrison transformation and area–charge estimates. In the limiting geometry, the bifurcation sphere has area radius one and constant electric and magnetic flux densities when the original ADM mass is normalized to one.
